vin.description: The 17-character VIN exactly as printed on the page. Null if no VIN appears anywhere in the text. Never construct, guess, or infer a VIN from partial characters.

model.description: The full model name as the page's own title prints it, keeping a variant word such as Hybrid, Prime, or Plug-in as part of the model and never moving it into trim, e.g. Insight, Corolla Hybrid, Camry Hybrid, Prius, Prius Prime.

trim.description: The trim grade alone, e.g. LE, SE, XLE, Limited, without the model or a variant word such as Hybrid ('Toyota Corolla Hybrid / LE Sedan 4D' is model 'Corolla Hybrid', trim 'LE'). Null if no trim is stated.

price.description: Asking price in US dollars as a plain number, no currency symbol or thousands separators. Null if no price is stated.

mileage.description: Odometer mileage in miles as a plain integer. Null if no mileage is stated.

dealerName.description: The selling dealer's name exactly as printed on the page (e.g. 'Holler Honda'). Null if no dealer name is stated, such as a private-party listing.

dealerLocation.description: The selling dealer's city and state as printed on the page, e.g. 'Winter Park, FL'. Null if no dealer location is stated.

fuelType.description: The fuel or drivetrain type as the page states it in a spec line, e.g. Gas, Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid, Electric. Null if no spec line states one.

smartKeyEntry.description: Whether the car has smart-key (proximity) entry, read ONLY from the listing's window sticker or factory equipment list, never from the dealer's description, highlights, or feature badges. 'present' when the sticker lists a Smart Key System or proximity entry; 'absent' when the sticker's equipment list names only a fob 'Keyless Entry' (or turn-key ignition) and no smart key or proximity item. Null when the page has no window sticker or equipment list.

pushButtonStart.description: Whether the car has push-button start, read ONLY from the listing's window sticker or factory equipment list, never from the dealer's description, highlights, or feature badges. 'present' when the sticker lists push-button start (a Toyota 'Smart Key System' includes it); 'absent' only when the sticker states a turn-key or keyed ignition, or says there is no push-button start, and lists no push-button or smart key item. A sticker that lists only a fob 'Keyless Entry' leaves push-button start null, since a fob says nothing about how the car starts. Null when the page has no window sticker or equipment list.

keylessFobEntry.description: Whether the car has a remote keyless fob ('Keyless Entry', 'Remote Keyless Entry'), read ONLY from the listing's window sticker or factory equipment list, never from the dealer's description, highlights, or feature badges. 'present' when the sticker lists a keyless entry or key fob item; 'absent' only when the sticker states a turn-key or keyed ignition or says there is no keyless entry, and lists no keyless entry, fob, smart key or proximity item. Null when the page has no window sticker or equipment list, or the sticker says nothing on the point.
